STATIC_DECISION.canonical_encoding: Field order above, BE integers, u32 byte length then unnormalized strict UTF8, fixed32 hashes. ID preimage excludes LABEL_IDENTITY only, includes namespace/version. No NULL/extra fields. Size bounded by exact field sizes plus namespace length.
STATIC_DECISION.publication_identity: SHA256(namespace UTF8 || complete canonical label bytes || u64 expected_previous_revision || bytes32 expected_previous_digest)
STATIC_DECISION.store: Separate private label append journal owned solely by existing NATIVE_REGISTRY_WRITER actor10; HEALTH_GUARD actor8 has read-only descriptor and submits proposals, never writes. The four existing registry record schemas remain byte-identical. Label journal does not grant generation/publication authority or mutate registry revision. OS enforcement binding remains under N1-SCALAR-SYSCALL-IR.
STATIC_DECISION.label_commit_record: Domain ASCII FLOOOW/P0090/R5N2/LABEL_COMMIT/V2 then u32 BE complete frame length; frame:u16 version2,u16 writer10,u16 observer8,u64 label_revision,u64 expected_previous_revision,bytes32 previous_label_digest,bytes32 observed_registry_tip_digest,u64 observed_registry_sequence,u32 label_length,complete label bytes,u16 state2(COMMITTED); Ed25519 signature64 over domain plus complete frame; trailer SHA256(frame||signature). Record revision starts1 with previous_revision0/previous_digest allzero under fresh independent HOST-approved context; never reset inside same context. Label max65536 bytes; no other record types accepted.
STATIC_DECISION.CAS: NATIVE_REGISTRY_WRITER serializes both its registry and label writes under one owned lock. Compare expected previous label revision/digest, expected exact registry tip sequence/digest and current generation high water; require all equal and no pending registry transition. Append full label commit with next label_revision=previous+1 (overflow reject), checksum/signature and previous label digest; fsync label journal, require independent HEALTH_GUARD read-back receipt before eligibility. Release lock only after receipt or durable UNKNOWN quarantine. Consumers verify writer signature and guard receipt binding both exact tips, then revalidate current generation and registry tip at use; any registry advance invalidates label, no fallback. Missing writer/observer continuity => UNKNOWN. No fieldwise publication.

transitions.PREPARED: No authority. Full record validated but no commit receipt.
transitions.COMMITTED: Only after durable commit acknowledgment and complete chain/tuple validation.
transitions.REJECTED: Malformed/conflicting/unauthorized publication; cannot upgrade this identity.
transitions.UNKNOWN: Incomplete durability/chain/observer evidence; no authority until full independent recovery validates the same commit.

STATIC_DECISION.duplicate: Same publication ID and byte-identical committed record => return same receipt, no new revision/use. Same ID different bytes or predecessor => REJECTED.
STATIC_DECISION.partial: No complete frame/checksum/signature => UNKNOWN; never parse a valid prefix as label.

crashes.during: Incomplete frame => UNKNOWN; complete durable commit recoverable only under preserved journal recovery.
crashes.after: Committed chain is recovered; prior one-use consumption is retained, never reset.

STATIC_DECISION.replay: Older generation/revision/context/work or consumed publication => REJECTED; exact duplicate receipt does not grant a second use.
STATIC_DECISION.mismatch: Generation or registry mismatch => REJECTED. Unknown current high water => UNKNOWN. Both not qualified.
STATIC_DECISION.future_verification: Measure installed label store/consumer policy identities, inject each state/crash/CAS mismatch into isolated future harness; require no accepted label before complete commit. No installed enforcement claimed.
